model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the trends in four different economic sectors over a range of years, with the x-axis representing time (though not explicitly labeled with years, the progression is implied by the increasing values on the x-axis) and the y-axis showing a numerical value, likely employment or output, ranging from 0 to 200,000 in increments of 50,000. The x-axis is linear and spans from approximately 0 to 10, with tick marks at regular intervals, though the specific units are not labeled. The y-axis is also linear, with labeled gridlines at 0, 50,000, 100,000, 150,000, and 200,000. Four distinct lines represent different sectors: the orange line (Селско, горско и рибно стопанство — Agriculture, forestry, and fishing) remains nearly flat near zero throughout, with a slight dip and rise near the end. The gray line (Преработваща промишленост — Processing industry) starts at around 25,000, fluctuates between approximately 25,000 and 50,000 until the midpoint, then rises sharply to nearly 190,000 by the end. The yellow line (Търговия; ремонт на автомобили и мотоциклети — Trade; repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles) remains close to zero for most of the period, then increases slightly to around 10,000 before leveling off. The blue line (Създаване и разпространение на информация и творчески продукти; далекосъобщения — Creation and distribution of information and creative products; telecommunications) starts at around 30,000, dips to near zero, then rises steeply to approximately 175,000 by the end. All lines show significant growth in the latter half of the time period, with the gray and blue lines exhibiting the most dramatic increases.
